description: Object type for type=adapter adapter_type=ldap conf entries.

bindParameters.description: Bind parameters for this LDAP adapter.
bindParameters.label: Bind Parameters

preventVerifyCert.description: Specify true to prevent the ldap server certificate from being verified when url uses the LDAPS scheme. If this parameter is false or not specified, the adapter does not influence the decision to verify the server certificate.
preventVerifyCert.label: Prevent Verify Cert

url.description: URL of LDAP Server. For example, ldaps://ldap-server:636. This template is evaluated when the adapter is started (plain strings are unchanged; substitutions such as environment:: may be used).
url.label: Url
